relationships.subject: supracallosal anterior cingulate cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: the role of the supracallosal anterior cingulate cortex is to learn associations between actions and the rewards/punishers that follow the actions

relationships.subject: orbitofrontal cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: have connectivity to the pregenual anterior cingulate cortex, which is strongly activated by rewards

key_findings: Unified theory: motivation is goal-directed action for rewards/punishers, emotion is state elicited by their receipt or omission.
Supracallosal ACC mediates action-outcome learning; OFC represents reward value; human amygdala has weak effective connectivity back to cortex.
